articles.headline: Bit Digital, Inc. Reduces Secured Borrowings from Galaxy Through Partial Sale of ETH Holdings
articles.description: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced that it has repaid $50 million of principal under its secured borrowing arrangement with Galaxy Digital. The repayment, funded through a partial sale of the Company’s ETH holdings, lowered outstanding Galaxy borrowings from $100.0 million to $50 million, a reduction of 50%.

articles.headline: Bitcoin, ethereum gain ground under new CFTC rules
articles.description:
Scott Melker discusses the changes to Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) regulations that allow bitcoin (BTC-USD), ethereum (ETH-USD), and stablecoins to count toward qualifying financial resource requirements for eligible exchanges and trading platforms. Melker examines what the regulatory shift could mean for institutional crypto adoption
